pages.title: Coal Generator
pages.text: Copper, iron, a furnace and aluminum wire. It burns coal and powers nearby machines through wire. It also pollutes, so put a chimney next to it: see the $(l:ecology_inst/page06)Ecology$() section.

pages.title: Machine order
pages.text: $(li)Circuit Fabricator: makes wafers.$(li)Compressor: burns coal and presses metal into sheets.$(li)Electric Compressor: gives twice as many sheets.$(li)NASA Workbench: builds rockets.

pages.title: Tier one wafer
pages.text: Make a basic wafer in the Circuit Fabricator. It unlocks the planet entries and gives you the Galactic Research book, which has the recipes for power, the telescope and rockets.

pages.title: What to gather
pages.text: Space eats a lot of metal. Stock up on iron, copper, tin, aluminum, silicon, coal, redstone and diamonds early. Silicon lies deep, so look for it below the other ores.

pages.title: Prelaunch Checklist
pages.text: Tick off fuel, oxygen, parachute and launch pad before takeoff. Crafted from canvas and red dye.

pages.title: Circuit Fabricator
pages.text: Makes wafers from diamonds, silicon and redstone.

pages.title: Compressor
pages.text: Burns coal and presses metal into sheets.

pages.title: Electric Compressor
pages.text: Runs on power and gives twice as many sheets.

pages.title: Basic Wafer
pages.text: Needed for almost every space machine.
